newsitem.title: USA: Schleipman to join Prudential muni underiting.
newsitem.headline: Schleipman to join Prudential muni underiting.

text.p: Pete Schleipman, formerly a senior vice president in Dillon Read & Co's municipal syndicate unit, is joining Prudential Securities municipal bond department as a vice president in underwriting.
His start date is effective Aug 1.
Dillon Read recently decided to leave the municipal bond business.

Other Dillon Read muni professionals have being joining other firms recently as well. Harry Tyson has joined First Albany Corp. as a senior vice president in the firm's public finance department. --U.S. Municipal Desk, 212-859-1650
